''' Room 1428''' was a room in the [[Grand Oradin Hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].

It was the designated meeting place between the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Whistler]] and [[R5-G8/Legends|Gate]] with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chief [[Talon Karrde]]. The droids played out a series of tones to indicate their arrival, but as a failsafe against traps, Karrde emerged behind them from [[Room 1429]].
